name: OOH Single Statement
description: One line and one mark. A single oversized statement holds the centre, the brand sits in a fixed corner, and an optional image is a full field behind rather than a separate element. Everything that is not the message has been removed.
spacing: The statement occupies most of the panel with wide clear space on every side, and the brand mark is held in one corner well inside the safe area.
responsive_behavior: Between the 16:9 and 3:1 panels the type reflows from two lines to one and grows in size. The brand mark keeps its corner and its clear space at both ratios.
